## SECTION 7 — Global Health & Biosecurity Watch
The U.S. government, through BARDA's Project BioShield, has exercised a $36.9 million procurement option with Shionogi for Fetroja® (cefiderocol). This is intended as a critical countermeasure against difficult-to-treat Gram-negative bacterial infections and high-priority biothreat pathogens like *Burkholderia pseudomallei* (melioidosis) and *Yersinia pestis* (plague). The contract also includes plans to establish a U.S. manufacturing site for Fetroja and expand its utility for pediatric patients.
